text:
Silver Price in 2007
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2007, the LBMA silver price rose 10.5% between 2007-01-31 ($13.36) and 2007-12-31 ($14.76). The highest sampled price was $14.76 in December and the lowest was $11.95 in August. The mean of these observations was $13.51. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
